scope_of_deliverables.quote: Implementation and Data Update of Asset Management Software ... The Villages are requesting responses to select a consultant to both implement and update data within the Villages Asset Management Software (AMS), consisting of Munisoft PubWorks and ESRI ArcGIS.
scope_of_deliverables.value: The Villages are seeking a consultant to implement and update their Asset Management Software, including Munisoft PubWorks and ESRI ArcGIS, to improve functionality and ease of use.

mandatory_submission_requirements.quote: 1. Submission Form (Appendix B) Each quotation must include a Submission Form (Appendix B) completed and signed by an authorized representative of the respondent. 2. Pricing (Appendix C) Each quotation must include pricing information that complies with the instructions contained in Pricing (Appendix C). Proponents are encouraged to view the proposed locations before submission of pricing. Use Bid Form attached as a separate document (Annex B). 3. Other Mandatory Submission Requirements Evidence of Safety Program and Insurance Upon notice of intent to negotiate, the Proponent will be required to supply: A valid copy of a current WCB clearance letter with the executed contract and with each invoice submitted for payment. Provide evidence of an active safety program such as providing a valid copy of an Alberta Certificate of Recognition (COR or SECOR or other Industry Partner certificate) or other evidence of an active workplace safety program. A valid certificate of insurance with coverage not less than Two (2) Million dollars from an insurance company legally capable of carrying on business within the province of Alberta, names the Village as an additional insured with cross liability, and provides an minimum 30 days notice of any changes to the policy.

mandatory_technical_requirements.quote: M-1 Proponent must confirm employees working on the City’s network are willing to sign a Non-Disclosure Agreement and complete a security clearance. M-2 Proponent must confirm they will use Microsoft Teams or Virtual Private Network (VPN) to access any software on the City’s network. M-3 Proponent must disclose whether their company and/or software has ever had a security breach or experienced a cybersecurity event that compromised the system or client base. If yes, describe the nature of the breach(es) or event and how it was resolved. M-4 Proponent must confirm all mandatory requirements which apply to the Proponent will also apply to any sub-contractors or 3rd Party
